name: @wazir/desktop
description: Wazir Desktop — native shell around the Wazir API and web dashboard

wazir.excludeFromCliBuildReason: tauri build requires Cargo and network access to crates.io; the CLI never depends on it.

scripts.build: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); if (process.platform === 'linux' && spawnSync('pkg-config', ['--exists', 'dbus-1']).status !== 0) { if (process.env.WAZIR_SKIP_DESKTOP_NATIVE_BUILD === '1') { console.log('[@wazir/desktop] Skipping native Tauri build on headless Linux (WAZIR_SKIP_DESKTOP_NATIVE_BUILD=1)'); process.exit(0); } console.error('[@wazir/desktop] ERROR: native Tauri build requires dbus-1.pc and webkit2gtk on Linux'); process.exit(1); } const res = spawnSync('npx', ['--no-install', 'tauri', 'build', '--no-bundle'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(res.status ?? 1);"
